card.name: Broken bullet symbol after sentence end
card.fires_on: A garbled bullet or replacement-character piece that starts a new list item right after a sentence ends, mostly in drug-label dosing lists. Also fires on the word 'artistic' before 'circles'.

modes.label: Garbled bullet in dosing lists
modes.description: A broken bullet character begins a new line after a dose or instruction ends with a period or reference number.

modes.label: Word before circles
modes.description: An adjective such as 'artistic' sits just before the word 'circles' in general prose.

card.writes: It suppresses 'circle' words, with no clear sense in what it promotes.
card.plain: It fires on a broken bullet mark that starts a new item in a dosing list, and once on 'artistic' before 'circles'.
